title: Clumsy Crucible
description: Find minimum heat loss path with direction movement constraints.
writeup:
## Approach

This is a shortest-path problem with an unusual constraint: the crucible must not move more than a certain number of consecutive steps in the same direction, and (in part 2) must move a minimum number before turning.

## Part 1

Dijkstra's algorithm with state `(row, col, direction, consecutive_steps)`. The crucible can move at most 3 steps in the same direction before it must turn. At each state, try continuing straight (if under the limit) or turning left/right.

## Part 2

The "ultra crucible" must move at least 4 steps in a direction before turning, and at most 10. Same Dijkstra approach but with `min_straight=4` and `max_straight=10`. The destination only counts if the crucible has completed at least 4 steps in its current direction.
